<set-variable name="filePath" value="@{
        string body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);  
        string pattern = @"name=""file_path""\s*(.*)";  
        var match = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(body, pattern, System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.Singleline);  
        string filePathBlock = match.Success ? match.Groups[1].Value.Trim() : string.Empty;  
        string[] lines = filePathBlock.Split(new string[] { "\r\n", "\n" }, System.StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);  
        return lines.Length > 0 ? lines[0] : string.Empty;
    }" />
